nora: Heads up — EU ingest is emitting a second wave of late events (1.5-3h). Recompute queue rising. Can we gate background rehydrates so live p95 doesn't regress? cc @ishaan

ishaan: Agree. Two quick knobs: 1) admit-only-if-spot-available (tier_hint=spot_if_free) 2) small dedupe pass before enqueue to cut obvious duplicates.

kevin: Suggest a simple API add: `tier_hint` string + `precheck.dedupe=true` flag. Example: `POST /internal/replays {"tenant":"foo","window":"2h","tier_hint":"spot_if_free","precheck.dedupe":true}`

ingest-bot: ALERT: shard=eu-north lag=5400 count=600 sample_keys=***

ops: If we route to spot pools we need telemetry tags and quota request. Use `rb-tool quota request --tenant foo --pool spot-dedicated-eu --tokens 600000 --hours 2` and include this thread link. We'll triage fast.

nora: Console UX: add a small checkbox "Prefer spot pool if available (may be preempted)" with inline cost + wait estimate. Hide if tenant doesn't have quota. Lina can make copy later.

ishaan: Scheduler behavior: honor `tier_hint` only if queue_depth.shared < threshold AND spot capacity exists. If preempted, auto-fallback to shared with exponential backoff. Also attach `meta.routing_hint=spot_if_free` so billing/telemetry are clear.

kevin: Safety: admission control rule — keep background lane concurrent_tokens <= 4M in region; if exceeded, downgrade incoming to passive queue. Also throttle if api_p95 > 2x baseline.

ops: Created quota ticket: rb-tool quota request --tenant foo --pool spot-dedicated-eu --tokens 600000 --hours 2 (ticket 8427). We'll watch SLOs and alert if regressions.

console-bot: Note: scheduler should return `cost_estimate` in replay create response: format tokens,string_cost,p50_wait_ms. Console will render that for the checkbox.

nora: Plan: roll ff on scheduler for `tier_hint` in staging, enable console toggle behind ff, run 2-hour canary for tenant=foo starting 08:00 UTC. If p95 or error-rate increases, revert routing ff. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
